messages:
anya: Heads-up — found unexpected credits after today's NetSuite push. Looks like some Stripe webhook payloads lost the `idempotency_key` header on proxy retries and our consumer created duplicate invoice adjustments.

brad: Ouch. How many customers and any posted invoices?

anya: Quick tally: 7 customers affected, 3 had invoices posted. Exported details to internal sheet: https://redwood.internal/fin/webhook-header-loss (private).

anya: Example log: ```2026-08-14T03:12:07Z WARN webhook-consumer: stripe_event=evt_5Kz idempotency_key=null delivered_at=2026-08-14T03:11:58Z action=apply_adjustment result=applied```

brad: Root cause likely proxy drop on retry path. Consumer currently prefers header dedupe. Quick mitigation: fall back to stripe_event_id-based dedupe and run a targeted cleanup. I'll open a PR.

infra-bot: nightly-summary 2026-08-14T04:05:00Z - processed=3,050 failed=6 dlq=5 retry_spike=11

brad: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/fin-inc/pull/621 "webhook: fallback to stripe_event_id idempotency when header missing" — includes unit tests simulating lost headers. @anya can you validate cleanup plan? :eyes:

anya: Yep. Plan: (1) patch consumer to use stripe_event_id fallback, (2) dry-run cleanup in staging to detect duplicates, (3) live cleanup with finance validation, (4) add proxy header validation + metric. I'll run the dry-run tonight.

clare_fin: Hold off on customer notifications until finance reviews live results. We'll prepare comms if manual refunds/credits are needed.

deploy-bot: Deployed branch pr-621 to staging at 2026-08-14T07:12:02Z. smoke tests passed.

brad: Dry-run completed 2026-08-14T23:40Z — staging diff shows 7 adjustments, no duplicate credits created. Pushed CSV to PR.

anya: Live cleanup executed 2026-08-15T01:05Z — reconciled 7 customers, removed 3 duplicate adjustments, 2 invoices needed manual memos. Posting final sheet.

clare_fin: Finance validated; small memos approved and sales notified for enterprise accounts. Please add alert `billing.missing_idempotency_header > 0` and mark proxy team to hard-fail missing headers.

brad: Added metric and alert. Also added a proxy unit-test to preserve header on retries. Follow-ups: FIN-845 for the postmortem and longer DLQ retention for 72h.

anya: Closing loop. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
